security_audit.summary: Most static detections are Markdown formatting, documentation links, or prose about configuration files. Four command-related findings are confirmed because the skill tells agents to run local helper scripts that are not bundled with the package. No prompt injection or data exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.suggestion: Bundle init_skill.py and package_skill.py, or remove the commands. Tell agents to run only reviewed scripts with user approval.
Add a rule that generated scripts must never log, copy, or transmit values from .env files or process.env.
Mark command snippets as examples and include the expected working directory before any execution step.

content.value_statement: Building reusable AI skills requires clear scope, safe resources, and useful activation metadata. This skill guides structured planning, authoring, packaging, and iteration.
actual_capabilities: Explains required SKILL.md frontmatter and file layout.
Guides selection of scripts, references, and assets.
Shows how to plan reusable resources from concrete examples.
Provides initialization and packaging command examples.
Recommends concise metadata and progressive disclosure.
Outlines an iteration loop after testing a skill.
limitations: The package does not include the helper scripts it describes.
It provides guidance, not automated validation or scaffolding.
It focuses on Claude-style skill structure and terminology.
It does not audit the security of generated scripts.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Skill
use_cases.description: Define scope, trigger examples, reusable resources, and metadata before writing a new skill.

use_cases.title: Improve an Existing Skill
use_cases.description: Review structure, split long guidance into references, and clarify when bundled resources should be loaded.

use_cases.title: Package Skill Guidance
use_cases.description: Prepare user-facing instructions for validating, packaging, and iterating on reusable AI agent workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan a new skill for a repeated workflow. Ask only the key questions needed to define scope and examples.

prompt_templates.title: Design Skill Resources
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these workflow examples and identify which scripts, references, and assets should be included in the skill.

prompt_templates.title: Refine Skill Metadata
prompt_templates.prompt: Improve this skill name and description so an AI agent can decide when to use it correctly.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Skill Structure
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this skill for progressive disclosure, file organization, resource references, packaging readiness, and missing safety notes.

output_examples.input: A user wants to create a skill for repeated PDF editing tasks.
output_examples.output: The assistant proposes a focused PDF editing skill, identifies a reusable rotation script, and recommends concise activation metadata.

output_examples.input: A team has a long skill file with many API details.
output_examples.output: The assistant recommends moving detailed API material into references and keeping only core workflow steps in SKILL.md.

output_examples.input: A maintainer wants to prepare a skill for distribution.
output_examples.output: The assistant lists validation, packaging, cleanup, and iteration steps in a practical release checklist.

best_practices: Start from real user examples before choosing reusable resources.
Keep SKILL.md concise and move detailed material into references.
Bundle only scripts and assets that directly support repeated workflows.
anti_patterns: Do not create broad skills that combine unrelated domains.
Do not hide essential behavior in large reference files.
Do not include scripts without tests, dependencies, or safety notes.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create structured AI agent skills with clear metadata, reusable resources, and practical workflows.

faq.question: Does it generate a complete skill automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and examples, but this package does not include scaffolding scripts.

faq.question: Can it improve an existing skill?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide reviews of scope, metadata, file organization, and resource references.

faq.question: Which tools can use this marketplace listing?
faq.answer: The listing is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatibility.

faq.question: What files should a skill include?
faq.answer: A skill needs SKILL.md. It may also include scripts, references, and assets when useful.

faq.question: Does this skill validate security?
faq.answer: No. Authors should separately review generated scripts, dependencies, secrets handling, and command execution.
